worker_id.description: Unique name for this worker instance (used by the coordinator to identify it)

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent test jobs this worker can run simultaneously

work_dir.description: Root directory for worker state, logs, and test artifacts

package_cache_dir.description: Directory where downloaded test packages and metadata are cached

coordinator_url.description: Base URL of the debci coordinator server

api_token_file.description: Path to a file containing the API token used to authenticate with the coordinator

retry_delay.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed job (e.g., network error)

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for a failed job

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (info level and above)

debug.description: Enable debug logging (includes all info/warning/error messages plus detailed debug traces)

supported_architectures.description: List of CPU architectures this worker can build and test (e.g., 'amd64', 'arm64')

supported_releases.description: List of Debian/Ubuntu distribution releases this worker supports

environment.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables to export to test jobs (e.g., TZ, DEBEMAIL)

job_limits.description: Resource limits per job (applies to systemd/cgroupv2)

cpu_quota.description: CPU quota in microseconds per 100ms period (e.g., 50000 = 50% of one CPU core)

job_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) a single test job may run before being killed

cleanup_enabled.description: Automatically remove old test artifacts (logs, builds, etc.) to free disk space

cleanup_age_days.description: Delete test artifacts older than this many days

pre_test_hook.description: Optional absolute path to a script to run before each test job begins

post_test_hook.description: Optional absolute path to a script to run after each test job completes

lxc_enabled.description: Run each test job inside an isolated LXC container instead of the host

lxc_architecture.description: Architecture for LXC containers (should match supported_architectures)
